scope: Local first-order density-current action in its two-mass-endpoint limit, with complete form components on an ordinary two-dimensional oscillator plane. All normal blocks satisfy a common analytic separation criterion. The actual spatial source of the oscillator coefficients and the fast mass-carrier bands are outside this endpoint result.
